newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - Dollar seen biding time, building steam.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dollar seen biding time, building steam.

text.p: *Dlr/mark seen pressured short-term with 1.73 a key threshold. *Mark/yen recapture of 73 also weighs on dollar/mark, but fresh run to 3-year highs near 1.74 seen after consolidation period. *Various dollar support seen to 1.71 marks, with 1.7200-20 first. *Dlr/yen dances with 126 after overnight bounce off 125 floor. *Next caps seen 126.20-60 before retest of 127.20 56-mth high. *Frequent support to 125 yen, with 124.80, 124.40 for backup.
